description: One exercise name per session (#1340, owner decision). Exercises are [name, sets, group]; null group = ungrouped. dedupe: dedupeExercises keeps the first copy's place and fields, sums set counts capped at sets_max (a first copy already above it is not cut), then repairs groups (ADR 012). swap: replaceAt(exercises, [], idx, pick) with no history; the result is the list of [name, group] after, a pick already in the session changes nothing. import: planImport with the mapping given, ids g1, g2, ... in order; sets are [exercise, setIndex] in file order, groups are by stored name.  The plan engine needs no vector: it cannot repeat a name (resolveSession drops repeats, trimSession and applyFocus work from distinct names); an app test pins that over every template, place, length and focus.

dedupe.note: the #1329 repro: the later copy folds into the first
sets are capped at the limit
a first copy above the limit is not cut
later copy's group is dropped with it; the first copy's group stays
first copy ungrouped: the later copy's group does not carry over
a repeat of a member keeps the group, the first copy decides
a group of three keeps two valid members
a group split in two runs stays dissolved after the repeat goes

swap.note: pick not in the session: swapped
pick already in the session: refused, nothing changes
pick is the exercise itself: refused
a refused pick leaves a group alone

import.note: same exercise in two blocks: one entry, sets in file order, superset kept when all its sets agree
two imported names mapped to one stored name merge into one entry
a merged exercise whose sets disagree on the superset is ungrouped, and the partner is left alone
a merge that leaves the group non-adjacent is ungrouped whole
